text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio and I are on our way back
home from
shopping, when...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. You remember that
assignment Prez
gave me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I got an idea, actually!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I was chatting with Scarlet the other day,
and...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I see. What your trainer means to you...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally stuck on it! What would you
say,
Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a nice problem to have. I'm
still trying
to find a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But I suppose if I had to give an answer,
I'd say...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A trainer is someone who'd help me
achieve my
dreams. My most valuable
partner.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainers devote themselves to
supporting their
trainees, and we devote
ourselves to meeting
their expectations
in return.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
By working together, we can climb
higher.
Something like that, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wow, really? I see...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What's with that face? You're not
thinking of
doing something weird, are
you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
No way! Not at all! I'll just store this
away in the
ol' noggin for later.
Thanks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
What do you think about what she said,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Right? Of course the model student
would say
something like that! So I was
thinking...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I could tweak it a little, put in my own
words, and
tell it to Prez! Whaddya
think?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Am I smooth or what? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Am I smooth or what? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Bleh. I know...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But I used my brain to figure it out!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, no... But I don't think there's any
way she'll
find out either.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Then what is?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Teio looks at me with disappointment. I
tell her if
she wishes to surpass Rudolf,
she'll have to follow
her example in more
than just races.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Urk...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. Her conscience is so
sparkly clean
it hurts to look at.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. I'll figure out the answer by
myself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right! And Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Thanks for scolding me! I appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tokai Teio understand what she
did wrong
and apologize gives me the
feeling she has grown
a little.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. But it's still a great answer,
right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her I'm shocked and saddened that
she won't
even consider how she really
feels about me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: W-wait! I didn't mean it like that!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! Don't look so sad! That's not what
I meant!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, Tokai Teio is the one
who looks
to be on the edge of tears
now.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll try to think about what you mean to
me
properly this time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right! And Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Thanks for stopping me! I appreciate it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Tokai Teio understand what she
did wrong
and apologize gives me the
feeling she has grown
a little.
